name: CyberOne
summary: Canberra ISP (formerly ACT Online, 1996; TransACT/dialup); ISP service collapsed ~Jun 2012, customers absorbed by Apex Telecom (26 Jun 2012); pivoted to BPO/call-centre services.

events.details: ACT Online Internet became ISP Apr 1996; CyberOne Pty Ltd 1996.
ISP customers absorbed by Apex Telecom (26 Jun 2012).
